description: The Assembly '94 Invitation Dentro by Future Crew and Sonic PC, the organizers' second invitation to Assembly '94 in Helsinki, with a small Space Invaders game, running from its original files in your browser.
about: The Assembly '94 Invitation Dentro is the organizers' second invitation to Assembly '94, held from 5 to 7 August 1994 in Helsinki's Ice Hockey Hall, released on 3 July 1994. Future Crew made it with Sonic PC, who did the code.
It includes a small playable Space Invaders game: the arrow keys move the ship.
It never ends by itself: its second part, with the game, loops until Escape, which returns to DOS.
released: Released on 3 July 1994, as the organizers' second invitation to Assembly '94 (5 to 7 August 1994, Helsinki).
credits: Code by Mik of Sonic PC. Design and graphics by Marvel, music by Skaven, the music player by Psi and texts by GORE, of Future Crew.
terms: Freeware: “This demo is freeware. It can be freely distributed without modifications. No money can be charged for it.” (README.1ST)
accuracy: DosKit starts it with -c2, the Gravis UltraSound, and -q, its quick mode, which “runs thru both parts automatically”.
Its screen stays black for about 12 seconds at first while its music plays, which its readme says is normal.
Its -a switch would only empty the game's box, so DosKit runs it with the game.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
imageAlt: A screen of the Assembly '94 Invitation Dentro, running in DosKit
